% OUTLINE: The note defines units, supports, weighting, the resampling and the suppression rule.
\par\noindent{\footnotesize Set: the population, by its number of paragraphs. Units are paragraphs for technology ticks, technology rows for individual elements and comparison targets, and shared frame-bearing rows for evaluations. Pooled units are technology-row $\times$ element cells. 1st/2nd gives positive counts for binary items and applicable-unit counts for categorical items. Art. counts articles with a first-coding positive for binary items, and articles with an applicable unit otherwise. Raw is the share of units on which both codings agree; it and $\alpha$ are unweighted. Intervals use defined draws from 2{,}000 whole-article resamples (seed 20260905). $q$ is the fraction of defined draws below the stated benchmark. Undef. counts draws with no applicable units or no variation across ratings. An item below five first-coding support units has its $\alpha$ suppressed. Pooled cells summarise heterogeneous elements and certify none of them.\par}
